allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about Conversion of up to the total outstanding 56,00,000 Warrants, in one or more tranches, into an equivalent number of Equity Shares of Baazar Style Retail Limited.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of warrants convertible in to equity shares of  Baazar Style Retail Limited.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about allotment of bonus equity shares.

allot.subject: News Verification
allot.text: The Exchange has sought clarification from Cupid Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Baazar Style Retail shares decline 5% on Cupid's warrant deal announcement.  The response from the Company is attached.
